name: async-batchable-stateful
salesforceExclusionReason: API 67 clean-org rejects the fixture's Database.executeBatch overload shape; retained as local async evidence and excluded from hosted parity.

source.content: public class StatefulFixtureBatch implements Database.Batchable<Integer>, Database.Stateful { public Integer Counter = 0; public Iterable<Integer> start(Database.BatchableContext bc) { return new List<Integer>{1, 2}; } public void execute(Database.BatchableContext bc, List<Integer> scope) { Counter++; insert new Account(Name = 'stateful-count-' + Counter); } public void finish(Database.BatchableContext bc) { insert new Account(Name = 'stateful-finish-' + Counter); } }

public class NonStatefulFixtureBatch implements Database.Batchable<Integer> { public Integer Counter = 0; public Iterable<Integer> start(Database.BatchableContext bc) { return new List<Integer>{1, 2}; } public void execute(Database.BatchableContext bc, List<Integer> scope) { Counter++; insert new Account(Name = 'non-stateful-count-' + Counter); } public void finish(Database.BatchableContext bc) { insert new Account(Name = 'non-stateful-finish-' + Counter); } }

@isTest private class AsyncBatchableStatefulFixtureTest { @isTest static void statefulPreservesAndNonStatefulResetsInstanceFields() { Test.startTest(); Database.executeBatch(new StatefulFixtureBatch(), 1); Database.executeBatch(new NonStatefulFixtureBatch(), 1); Test.stopTest(); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'stateful-count-1']); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'stateful-count-2']); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'stateful-finish-2']); System.assertEquals(2, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'non-stateful-count-1']); System.assertEquals(0, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'non-stateful-count-2']); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'non-stateful-finish-0']); } }
